MINUTES

  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY COUNCIL

  SPECIAL MEETING

  WEDNESDAY, JULY 15, 2020 AT 5:30 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER
The Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to order by
Mayor Jesse Alvarado on Wednesday, July 15, 2020, at 5:35 PM in the City Council Chambers,
21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

Lucie Colombo, CMC, City Clerk, provided brief information relating to the conduct of the City
Council meeting as result of the COVID-19 pandemic.

INVOCATION
The invocation was led by Lucie Colombo, CMC, City Clerk.
FLAG SALUTE
The flag salute was led by Councilmember Victor Farfan.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  MAYOR  JESSE ALVARADO
  MAYOR PRO TEM  LUIS ROA
  COUNCILMEMBER  VICTOR FARFAN
  COUNCILMEMBER  MYRA MARAVILLA
  COUNCILMEMBER  HANK TRIMBLE

Lucie Colombo, CMC, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - ITEMS ONLY ON THE AGENDA

Lucie Colombo, CMC, City Clerk, provided brief information relating to the conduct of the Public
Comments section of the agenda as result of the COVID-19 pandemic.

Christine Roa submitted a comment.

Frances Rodriguez submitted a comment.

Luis Schmidt, AFSCME District Council 36, submitted a comment.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
SPECIAL MEETING
JULY 15, 2020
 A.  DISCUSSION

 1.  RESOLUTION NO. 062-2020
  AMENDING THE ADOPTED 2019-2021 CITYWIDE BUDGET AND
  APPROVING THE HAWAIIAN GARDENS 2020-2023 THREE-YEAR
  FINANCIAL PLAN.

 Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, provided staff report and power point presentation
 and explained the need for a 3-year fiscal plan and the various amendments to the
 budget because of the COVID-19 pandemic.

 There was discussion and comments between the City Council and staff. Staff
 responded to various comments and concerns relating to the departments and
 operations. A summary of proposed budget adjustments were recommended,
 discussed, and made. The items discussed included Agenda Management
 System, remove $25, 000, Financial Management System in year 2 and 3,
 reinstate and not remove the Public Safety Commission, Sheriff’s Special
 Assignment Officer(s) (SAO), consider temporary budgetary adjustments since
 Card Club is closed and significant reduction of funds, Public Safety Officers, Sr.
 Administrative Analyst position

 By City Council consensus, they decided to remove the additional $25,000 relating
 the Agenda Management System

 It was moved by Councilmember Trimble, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, to
 reinstate the Public Safety Commission.

 The City Council took a brief recess at approximately 6:03 PM, after the motion
 was made and prior to the City Council vote.

 The City Clerk conducted the roll call vote and the motion was approved with the
 following votes:

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
 NOES:  NONE
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 5-0.

 It was moved by Councilmember Trimble, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, and
 approved by roll call vote to eliminate donations to the School District.

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
 NOES:  NONE
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 5-0.

 There was a substitute motion made by Mayor Prom Tem and it was not listed, so
 I removed the above motion which was not seconded.

 All City Councilmembers spoke.
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
SPECIAL MEETING
JULY 15, 2020
 A.  DISCUSSION ITEMS (CONTINUED)

 It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla to fund the Special Assignment Officer
 position and reduce the Sr. Administrative Analyst position to part-time 50%.

 Mayor Pro Tem Roa returned to the dais at approximately 6:17 PM.

 The motion was seconded by Councilmember Farfan and approved by roll call
 vote as follows:

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, ROA, ALVARADO
 NOES:  TRIMBLE
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 4-1.

 It was moved by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, and
 approved by roll call vote to cancel the Scholarship Dinner from the budget and
 continue the scholarships, with the following roll call vote:

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
 NOES:  NONE
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 5-0.

 It was moved by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, and
 approved by roll call vote to eliminate the 4th of July Event, with the following roll
 call vote:

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
 NOES:  NONE
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 5-0.

 It was moved by Councilmember Trimble, seconded by Councilmember Maravilla,
 and approved by roll call vote to keep the Carnival, with the following roll call vote:

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ALVARADO
 NOES:  ROA
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 4-1. Mayor Pro Tem Roa opposed.

 It was move by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Maravilla to
 eliminate Volunteer Dinner and substitute by extending invitation to attend the
 Employee Recognition Dinner

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
SPECIAL MEETING
JULY 15, 2020
 A.  DISCUSSION ITEMS (CONTINUED)

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
 NOES:  NONE
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 5-0.

 It was moved by Councilmember Trimble, seconded by Councilmember Maravilla,
 and adopted by roll call vote to approve Resolution No. 062-2020 to include
 amendments, and to amend the adopted 2019-2021 Citywide budget by
 implementing year one of the Hawaiian Gardens 2020-2023 three-year Financial
 Plan; to authorize the proposed reductions in revenues, the elimination of
 reduction in programs, services, and staffing and approving a spending plan of
 $17,809,100 for Fiscal Year 2020-2021 (Year One); and authorize comparable
 spending plans to “Year One” of the Hawaiian Gardens 2020-2023 Three Year
 Financial Plan for fiscal years 2021-2022 ($18,165,282) and 2022-2023
 ($18,528,588).

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
 NOES:  NONE
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 5-0.

 2.  REVIEW OF THE CITY-WIDE FEE SCHEDULE FOR THE MUNICIPAL
  SERVICES PROVIDED BY THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Provide staff direction.

 City Manager Hernandez provided a brief staff report.

 It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Councilmember Trimble,
 and approved by roll call vote to approve the proposed rate modifications to the
 Fee Schedule.

 AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
 NOES:  NONE
 ABSENT:  NONE
 ABSTAIN:  NONE

 Motion carried, 5-0.

 Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, spoke.

 Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, spoke.

 All City Councilmembers spoke.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
SPECIAL MEETING
JULY 15, 2020
 B.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items to be presented at this time.

C.  ADJOURNMENT

Mayor Alvarado adjourned the meeting at 6:34 PM, to the next Regular City Council meeting to
be held on Tuesday, July 28, 2020 at 6:00 PM.

  Respectfully submitted:

  ________________________________
  Lucie Colombo, CMC, CPMC
  City Clerk

  APPROVED:

  ________________________________
  JESSE ALVARADO
  MAYOR
